label: r3_a_direct_cycler_v2
config_content:
# Control experiment (2026-08-14): identical to r3_a_direct.yml in every
# respect except data -- A-2 is CyclerA2 (deterministic, independent of
# A-1) instead of the trained RL Green policy. Tests whether r3_a_direct's
# elevated h1->other (0.582, vs exp1_l1/exp3's ~0.01-0.04) is caused by
# A-2's RL-driven behavior or is architectural (present regardless of
# A-2's policy, e.g. from SM retraining from scratch on top of already-
# self/other-differentiated frozen vision encoders).
model:
    name: SuperpositionNetworkProbeQ
    config: default
    mode: ~
runner: PredictionFeaturePredictionRunner
data:
    name: r3_control_a1random_a2cycler
load_state_dict_strict: False
p_mask_vision: 0.99
train:
    loss_function: l1_loss
    pretrain:
        exp_config: exp1_l1
        seed: 0
        epoch: 200
    batch_size: 10
    max_epochs: 200
    save_interval: 10
    test_interval: 10
    optimizer: AdamW
    optim_config:
        default:
            lr: 0.001
            weight_decay: 0.01
        freeze:
            - vision_encoder_module
            - vision_decoder_module
            - integration_module
            - feature_prediction_module
            - share_lns
            - probe_critic
        per_params:
            - name: bias
              args:
                  weight_decay: 0.0
